Get EVALIDs and associated information for plots

Source: R/fia_design.R
fia_eval_info.Rd

Get information about the EVALIDs associated with plots from the various POP_* tables.

Usage

fia_eval_info(db)

Arguments

db

A list of tibbles produced by fia_load().

Value

A tibble with variables that can be used for stratified estimation that can be joined to annualized data.

Examples

db <- fia_load("RI", dir = system.file("exdata", package = "forestTIME"))
fia_eval_info(db)
